topic: Your brain learns what you repeatedly tolerate!

story.coreIdea: Every unfinished task keeps subconscious neural RAM occupied, leaking cognitive bandwidth until the system exhausts itself.
story.centralClaim: Mental exhaustion is not caused by the work you are doing, but by the unresolved loops you leave open.
story.viewerPromise: Understand why your mind feels cluttered even when sitting still, and how to close invisible neural loops.

emotionalArc.overall: Curiosity -> Tension & Cognitive Friction -> Epiphany Release -> Grounded Peace

agentContract.instructions: READ THIS BRIEF BEFORE IMPLEMENTING Canvas.tsx. The Shot Director defines WHAT the viewer must see; you as the AI editor decide HOW to realize it. Do not default to cards or slideshows. Ground ideas in physical mechanisms, open-stage choreography, and deliberate editorial rhythm.
agentContract.confidenceHierarchy:
REQUIRED: Narrative purpose, visual objective, and 5-question visual state change.
RECOMMENDED: Primary visual mechanism, composition mode, and camera movement.
OPTIONAL: Suggested components (you may invent or use better components).
agentContract.fiveQuestionsRule: For every shot, you must satisfy: 1) What exists at the beginning? 2) What happens? 3) What visibly changes? 4) What exists at the end? 5) Why does that change matter? If only text changes, redesign the scene around physical or spatial transformation.
